title: Split Flower of Time
description: A surreal cosmic scene centers on a large dark flower with clock-face petals, its two cat-like faces split by a white lightning bolt. The purple left face cries while the teal right face has a glowing red eye; red liquid drips downward. The flower grows from a gnarled, dead forest under a swirling galaxy sky containing a purple ringed planet, a flaming pentagram orb, and scattered mathematical symbols.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting of a giant flower with clock numerals on each petal, two cat heads in the center split by a bright white lightning bolt, one purple crying cat face and one teal cat face with glowing red eye, red liquid dripping from the flower, set against a swirling cosmic galaxy background with a purple ringed planet, flaming occult orb, dead gnarled trees in the foreground, scattered mathematical symbols floating in the air, mystical and chaotic atmosphere.
